messages:
mei (DevEx): FYI found a reproducible parity issue between Java and Kotlin SDKs around OkHttps retry and timeouts for streaming calls. Java sample sends one start; Kotlin sample sends two when network blips.

mei (DevEx): Repro: run sampleapp streaming generate on emulator, disable wifi for ~300ms, re-enable. Kotlin client often shows duplicate start events. Java client (older wrapper) does not.

mei (DevEx): Our SDK default OkHttp config in Kotlin: 
```kotlin
OkHttpClient.Builder()
  .retryOnConnectionFailure(true)
  .callTimeout(0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
  .connectTimeout(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
  .build()
```

nate (Android): Interesting. Could be due to differing interceptor behavior between the two wrappers. Are we buffering the request body anywhere?

mei (DevEx): No buffering on Kotlin path. We rely on retry interceptor to re-execute on IOExceptions. Snippet: 
```kotlin
try { return chain.proceed(req) } catch (e: IOException) { return chain.call().client().newCall(req).execute() }
```

ara (Platform): That re-execute pattern is risky for streaming bodies. If the body is unrepeatable (chunked), the second send will duplicate the server start. Java wrapper probably had a buffered sink or disabled retries.

vin (QA): I reproduced on Pixel 6 emulator Android 12. Added tcpkill to drop connection for 200-500ms -> duplicate start_id seen in server logs.

nate (Android): Quick mitigation: for endpoints that use Transfer-Encoding: chunked or where contentLength==-1, set retryOnConnectionFailure(false) and avoid the custom retry interceptor. Also check call.isCanceled after rotation.

mei (DevEx): Proposed immediate PR: 
- guard RetryInterceptor to skip retries when request.header("X-Stream")=="1" or contentLength==-1 
- change SDK sampleapp default to not auto-retry for streaming clients 
- add sampleapp CI test toggling network and asserting single start token

ara (Platform): LGTM. Longer term: offer an opt-in idempotency header X-Idempotency-Key so apps that want retries can provide a stable id for server dedupe. Also consider rebuffering for small requests (<=32KB) so safe retries are possible.

vin (QA): I'll add a CI job using adb and netem to simulate short blips and assert server saw exactly one start. Will add a flaky tag.

ci-bot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1801 - "Kotlin SDK retry path duplicates start on streaming calls after short network blips"

mei (DevEx): Thanks team. I'll open the PR with the RetryInterceptor guard and update the Android troubleshooting doc about streaming + retries. We'll follow up on idempotency header design.
